PR.body:
Round137 consolidates the accepted GI-TBC method, current run profile and maintained manuscript after the Round136 mainline integration. The paper-S2 entry now binds the actual frozen Round137 vectors; the declared AM and four mechanism controls isolate their intended changes.

The preregistered study completed all 120 native positions on 16 base inputs, 20 physical and 24 objective configurations. Seed0 breadth certifies GI-TBC 9/12 versus P 7/12 and PS 7/12; positive-resource configurations give 4/8 versus 0/8 and 0/8. The paper retains PS reversals, opposed endpoints, open n35 resource runs, limited Seed differences and the reversal of all three K15 deletion-time directions at Seed1. The stage decision retains AM .08, pair-only and AP off. Historical versions retain their own identities and denominators.

The R135 manuscript lineage now contains a question-led body, model/algorithm appendices, complete supplement, references, figures/tables and a visually checked 46-page PDF. Three author/source fact groups remain explicitly unconfirmed for discussion. All current outcomes and failures are preserved; commercial native assets, credentials and foreign full texts are excluded.

Validation includes 28 actual entry vectors plus six refusal cases without native execution, independent scientific/document/delivery review, all-page PDF visual acceptance, and a completed strict local pure replay of all 120 positions / 904 derived comparisons. Native computation was 118955.400563s (33.043167h) of the 60h ceiling, without adding nested H/LP/MIP twice.

Public recovery is explicitly layered: anonymous fixed-commit transfer and per-member recovery integrity completed for all 814 declared files, 123 archives and 1,399,812 members; the same immutable source/data passed the full local semantic replay. The additional full public-root semantic replay did not complete within the cumulative 9000s I/O/deadline bound over two same-root attempts. The original public receipt remains passed=false, both failures/logs and the diagnostic root are retained, and no full-public-semantic PASS is claimed. The independent scope/closeout review accepts the separately evidenced byte recovery plus local semantics for user H/G2's finite check; the frozen stronger policy and this disclosed limitation are preserved. No Optimize, build, vendor-DLL load or historical campaign recovery was used.

Bounded post-PR cleanup removed only 46 reconstructible final page PNG duplicates (8,922,383 logical bytes); unique raw, failures, the public root, runtime/build/plot dependencies, PDF/sources, QA records, active tree, old rounds and user content remain. The protected original HEAD and three user modifications are unchanged. This PR remains open/Draft, base main; no merge or force-push.
